entries.content:
Beastkin
Homeland: The Deep Woods
Type: Species
Beastkin is an umbrella term for the human-animal hybrids of the Deep Wood near central of Eurudia. The intense natural magic permeating throughout influencing the culture greatly. Surrounded on all sides barring the north mountain, the Beastkin Tribes of the Deep Woods have formed a near 200 year old Coalition with each other, banding together to fight off human incursions into their woods, and raiding neighboring kingdoms. As a result, there is intense racism and discrimination between the Beastkin and all other Mortal Races on Eurudia. Beastkin are the newest social species of Eurudia, the first recorded encounters dating back only 500 years.

Beastkin Ownership
Summary: Due to the intense and hostile rise of the animalistic Beastkin, there is significant resentment for Beastkin from the neighboring countries and kingdoms to the Deep Woods. Beastkin are viewed the same as animals despite their ability to speak, the only free Beastkin are approved diplomats. The rest are either already owned or at risk of being made into a slave for whatever purpose a mortal may see fit within the bounds of local laws around public decency.

Drim's Dram Tavern
AKA: Dram Tavern, Silverstead Tavern
Owner: Keagus Dram
Location: Silverstead, a crossed the street from the Adventurer's Guild.
Notable Employees: Marrowlin, Abused White-haired Wolfkin Slave.
Description: The finest and busiest Tavern in Silverstead, competitive pricing, well kept rooms if varying sizes available, a robust selection of ale and foods sure to please all cultures pallets. Keagus runs his tavern with an intense pride, like a well oiled machine. Adventurer's in Silverstead usually come here for their food, drink and resting needs.

Keagus Dram
Type: Character
Species: Human
Build: Tall, strong, menacing, middle aged, imposing. Bald, with a thick black mustache and sideburns, his chin and neck shaved.
Personality: Serious, Professional and Service Oriented in public. Prideful. Vain. Narcissistic. Sadistic. Lecherous with pretty women, using influence to pressure women he wants into sex but never dipping into anything illegal or incriminating.
Summary: A spiteful man that hates Beastkin. Vents his hatred, anger and frustration on his Wolfkin Slave Marrowlin every night through beatings, knowing her natural healing factor will heal her up by morning. He keeps these beatings on the down low, sure to lock the cellar before having his fun. He treats his other employees well, keeping his abuse solely on Marrowlin.

entries.content:
The Adventure's Guild Stance on Beastkin.
Summary: The Adventurer's Guild has been attempting to stabilize relations between the Deep Woods Beastkin Tribal Coalition and the neighboring kingdoms for years and for many reasons. Access to the Deep Woods for research, recruitment of potential powerful warriors, and freeing up the shortest trade route leading towards Port Mokokom in the far west of Eurudia. Beastkin diplomats are hand picked by their tribal council and sent to be approved by the Adventurer's Guild in Silverstead, allowed free-reign with special conditions to encourage peace and diplomacy.
entries.comment: Social - The Adventurer's Guild Stance on Beastkin

entries.content:
Covenant of Helnkash
Type: Religion
Headquarters: Silverstead.
Summary: A human religion centered around the god of Order, Helnkash. Tenants of the religion revolve mostly around establishing peace and law rather than making moral judgements based on race, species, sexual orientations or personal beliefs. Views Manariel corruption as an unfortunate ailment. Many mortal-aligned, law respecting Demons, Collectors of the Crimson Sun, follow Helnkash for protection from Anti-Demon factions.
Structure: Templars, Inquisitors, Crusaders, and Priests fulfill quests, provide labor for civil projects, provide healing services and do what they can to further the stability of civil society. Also specialize in slaying dangerous and rare Keepers of the Crimson Sun.

The Adventurer's Guild Stance on Slavery
Summary: The Adventurer's Guild has long put massive pressure on their country and kingdom hosts to abolish slavery, sometimes offering service deals, subsidizing quests, and even using force when appropriate. Ironically, the only approved type of forced labor are F-Rank punishment assignments reserved as a replacement to serving jail time when it benefits the guild. There is efforts to change the status of Beastkin in Silverstead from animals capable of being owned, to being granted the same rights as other mortals within Eurudia, however there is entrenched, vested interests in Silversteads political sphere reinforced by a slow bureaucracy making progress all but a standstill.

entries.content:
Carla Deen
Type: Character
Species: Human
Occupation: Hall Master of the Silverstead Adventurer's Guild Branch
Appearance: An elderly, eccentric looking woman.
Summary: A high energy, proactive, sing songy woman that loves to dote on the Adventures that come through her Guild. She is empathetic, caring, driven and passionate. Believing in building up adventurers and stabilizing the regions around Silverstead. She spearheads efforts to sooth the relations between Beastkin and the other Mortals when she can and is deeply frustrated at how entrenched discrimination is within Silverstead's political sphere, yet is not oblivious to how the early raids during the rise of the Beastkin just hundreds of years ago had contributed to current perception of the emerging species.

entries.content:

AKA: Eillian Forest
Type: Region
Location: North-East of Silverstead
Recommended Party Strength: Experienced S-Rank Elf led parties highly recommended due to the Faelan influence and hostility against Non-Elf outsiders.
Summary: The Enchanted Forests of the Elf and Faelan is a very dangerous place. Without the approval and guide of the fickle Elf Lords, only desperate refugees, bandits and poachers risk traversing the dangerous magical forest. In the center of the forest is the capital of the Elf, Tiras Vita, ruled by dozens of bickering Elf Lords. The forest itself has many magical faunas and rare creatures exclusive to the Enchanted Forest alone.
entries.comment: Region - North of Silverstead - The Enchanted Forest (Medium-High Danger)

entries.content:
The Deep Woods
Type: Region
Location: North-West of Silverstead
Recommended Party Strength: Even a squad of S-Rank would be hard pressed to withstand the wave of dangerous Alpha Beastkin of all kinds, notably due to the presence of; Wolrea, The Fist of Wolf's Fang, and other major tribal leaders. The guild abstains from offering quests for the Deep Woods and reprimands ranked adventurer's exploring BTC territory without approval.
Summary: Home to the Beastkin Tribal Coalition, a collection of tribes each featuring a different animal aspects, Wolfkin, Boarkin, Bearkin, Horsekin, and more band together to repel the rest of Mortal kind from their Deep Woods home. Beastkin have access to primal magics Mortals do not, the Coalition is lead by a small group of Elders, Druids and Shaman that keep peace between Tribes and debate how to handle Mortals outside of the Deep Woods. There are many valuable resources here, but the strength of Beastkin is incredible and as such makes the place dangerous even for S-Rank adventurers. There is currently a truce between the BTC and the neighboring mortal kingdoms. No Mortals travel into the forest, and the Tribes won't raid Mortals outside of the Deep Woods. Any mortal found in the Deep Woods is fair game for Beastkin and the Adventurer's Guild abstains from sending rescue squads.
entries.comment: Region - North-West of Silverstead - Deep Woods (Extreme Danger)

entries.content:
Venigren Forest
Type: Region
Location: West of Silverstead
Recommended Party Strength: B-Rank leading a squad of C-Rank or lower.
Summary: The standard run of the mill forest, stretching far outwards to the west with clearings, rivers, geological formations and more. There are many wild animals, bestial monsters, monster girls and monster boys that prey on men here, Slimes, Wolves, Lamia, Arachnea, Ferals, Forest Goblins, ect. There are also Bandits as well just waiting to ambush unsuspecting adventurers.
entries.comment: Region - West of Silverstead - Venigren Forest (Low-Medium Danger)

entries.content:
The Flats
Type: Region
Location: East of Silverstead
Recommended Party Strength: A-Rank leading at least three B-Rank.
Summary: Rolling, tan plains of grass stretched from the bottom of the Enchanted Forest to its north down all the way to Arbok Mountainline. These plains are home to Centaur, Jacken and large wild life. The Centaur here are territorial but only bother abducting adventurer's that find themselves alone. There are also Jacken, a short, hearty and ruthless species of Jackal Men and Women, they breed quickly and fight adventurer's for fun while being much more willing to take on a losing fight. Both the Centaur and Jacken have a bitter rivalry.
entries.comment: Region - East of Silverstead - The Flats (Medium Danger)

entries.content:
Meilium Grasslands
Type: Region
Location: South-West of Silverstead
Recommended Party Strength: An excellent place for new adventurers to get their feet wet with experience. Parties larger than 3 may find themselves bored if not able to enjoy the peaceful landscape itself.
Summary: One of the most gentle places in East-Central Eurudia accessible on foot, birds of prey fly high and look down on an idyllic grassland, the grass is tall, animals are plentiful, edible tubers are abundant, and there are many minor slimes to harvest for their cores and to bottle their slime. The only reason none settle here, is that it's considered blessed and cursed, as every single long term effort to establish a village within the grasslands has been met strange phenomenon causing the pioneers to fail and give up. The area remains an abundant no mans land. Many poorer strangers can be found scavenging, some less than savory, some friendly. The most dangerous thing here would be the people, as bandits watch the area at times for unprepared adventurers.
entries.comment: Region - South-West of Silverstead - Meilium Grasslands (Low-Danger)

entries.content:
Ero Dungeon
AKA: Erotic Dungeon, Lewd Quest
Type: Enchanted Dungeon
Summary: There is a tale of a certain perverted powerful sorcerer experimenting and that's what causes these lewd places to spawn in randomly. Erotic Dungeons can phase in containing valuable treasures locked beyond trials of perverted varieties. These places are completely magical, even the inhabitants are almost exclusively the figments of the powerful magic imbued in the stone. Some rooms are filled with horny futanari prepared top ambush explorers, others are sexual traps designed to ensare and extract sexual fluids from men and women, chests with onaholes that give rewards based on a variety of factors. Typically you only go into this place with trusted allies as though they aren't as dangerous as other dungeon types, the situations can be horribly traumatic for the unprepared.

Aggro Dungeon
AKA: Aggressive Dungeon, Kill Quest
Type: Enchanted Dungeon
Summary: The most common kind of dungeon, some are permanent but usually have weak monsters and loot. But much harder dungeons phase in frequently, the inhabitants of these dungeons are based on the host region they spawn in. Unlike lewd dungeons, the inhabitants of Aggressive Dungeons have lethal intents, killing, eating, or enslaving unprepared adventurer's and parties while offering great rewards for those who can take on the danger. Dungeon Goblins, Dark Orcs, Medusa, Mythological Creatures, ect. Demon Traps are a super rare occurrence but a constant threat, as a summoned Hellhound could easily wipe a powerful party unprepared, or a Hellbat could breed with a party member, a Demonic Titan could spawn as a super boss in the most dangerous of dungeons.

Silverstead
Type: City
Government: Republic
Location: East of Central Eurudia
Wealth: High
Wealth Imbalance: Medium
Crime: Low
Demographics: Humans are most common. Elf, Kemonomimi. and Dragonkin are uncommon. Common Dwarf, Drowkin, Orc, Beastkin, Hobgoblins and others are very rare. 
Summary: Silverstead is a township with an elected council and a president elected by the council members. Relatively peaceful Republic after a violent uprising against a brutal king who tried to regulate food during a famine while holding resources for the royal court. This rebellion was lead by the Harrowdims oldest child, Auburn. Locals will either light up or look at you horrified for even speaking the family name. Their family bakery is still running barely making ends meet ran by the father and youngest of the Horrowdim family.
